reviews.basis: The section reproduces MEMA's request. Its general response rejects the claimed statutory minimum, explicitly addressing EMA rather than MEMA by name, while agreeing that some categories need more time. The final preamble retains 2027 for some vehicles and describes category-specific delays, not a uniform four-year rule.

reviews.sourceCondition: If EPA chooses to stay with MY2028
reviews.basis: The original note and agency excerpt agree on the conditional year. The complete timing response discusses reasonable costs and other commenters' cost objections, but does not separately establish addition of the specified facility, financial and scheduling burdens. Its referrals to preamble and RIA cost analyses are not a verified cost-model change.

ruleComparisons.proposalLocator: Executive Summary C and the solicitation beginning below Table ES-3 and continuing on the next page.
ruleComparisons.finalLocator: Executive-summary timing discussion and section II.B.2.i Final Standards.
ruleComparisons.observedChange: The final preamble describes slower early-year stringency and later Phase 3 starts for day-cab and heavy vocational categories. Some 2027 changes remain. Sleeper-cab standards still start in 2030 as proposed; some 2032 standards become more stringent.

sourceCautions.finding: Both sources retain MY2028 in the conditional note despite the surrounding request for no earlier than MY2028 and an assumed end-2023 finalization.
sourceCautions.handling: Do not replace the year with MY2027 or infer whether the condition was triggered.

sourceCautions.handling: Retain a collective-response link; do not convert it to an explicit named MEMA rejection or merge the organizations.

sourceCautions.finding: The published final preamble keeps some 2027 standards, calls the sleeper 2030 start unchanged, and describes higher 2032 stringency for several other categories. Proposal technology shares are illustrative rather than mandated sales.
sourceCautions.handling: Do not code uniform delay, an additional sleeper delay, blanket weakening, or individual causal uptake. Keep this as one existing request and one scoped comparison.
